messages:
maria: Quick sync — finalizing the "Cadence Capsule" onboarding drip. Need subject lines, send windows by region, and the webinar cross-promo block. Target launch next Tue.

sam: I can take AU/EU send windows. Proposed: APAC 9am AEST, EMEA 10am CET, NA 9am PDT. Keeps local mornings.

jonah: For segmentation, let's do: 1) product trial active last 7d, 2) signed-up but no usage, 3) enterprise leads (sales touch). Different CTAs per cohort.

emily: For the webinar promo: short 2-sentence blurb + single CTA. We should reserve the second email in the series for webinar invite only for cohort 1 & enterprise. Avoid over-mailing cold signups.

marcus: Suppression check: confirm we’re excluding bounce list + recent webinar attendees. Also ramp sends for new IPs — we'll stagger by domain to avoid spikes.

maria: Draft subject lines (A/B): 1) "Welcome to Cadence Capsule — quick setup in 5 mins" 2) "Get your first result with Cadence Capsule today". Thoughts?

sam: Both good. Variant 2 for trial-active cohort, variant 1 for cold signups. Add emoji test on a small slice? (use on 5% control)

jonah: Metrics to watch: 24h open, 7d activation rate, webinar RSVP rate. Set baseline from last onboarding flow: 18% open, 6% activation.

emily: Suggested webinar blurb: "See Cadence Capsule in action — live workshop + Q&A. Reserve your seat." CTA: "Save my spot" (primary) and link to recording for later.

marcus: Scheduling snippet for ESP (example):
```json
{"cohort":"APAC","send_time":"2026-05-12T09:00:00+10:00","throttle":"500/hr"}
```
Use throttles per region.

maria: Can someone draft the 2-email copy variants (short and long)? I’ll own final QA + tracking tags.

sam: I'll draft APAC copy and send_time matrix by EOD. Linking doc: https://redwood-internal/a/marketing/cadence-capsule-draft

jonah: I'll set up the tracking events and funnel in Amplitude. Ping me when you have final UTM params.

mailer-bot: campaign "cadence-capsule-onboard-v1" created in ESP; draft scheduled for review.

maria: Perfect. Action items: Sam = send windows + APAC copy; Jonah = tracking + UTMs; Emily = webinar blurb + two CTA variants; Marcus = suppression + throttle settings; Maria = QA + tags. Target: finalize by Friday.

sam: ✅ will do.

jonah: ✅

emily: ✅

marcus: ✅, I'll add IP ramp notes.

maria: Thanks team — small slices, measured rollout. :rocket:
